answer: At each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and evaluates an epoch polynomial committed in the Semaphore identity tree. Its RLN rate-limit secret is Shamir-shared through message proofs; duplicate messaging produces distinct evaluations whose interpolation reconstructs the private key and proves a limit violation. The contract verifies this evidence and executes instantaneous collateral slashing, making sybil identities costly, whether named mesa, sonnet, or umber.
